note: Declared LANE port bands on the shared development Mac (GH-687 follow-through; owner rulings 2026-09-07). PLAN rows: 30 ports per lane (the layout minimum — bandLayout needs an http half + a CDP half), contiguous, below the CI reserved range in ci-bands.json. LEGACY rows: the bands lanes were running on before the plan, kept until `until` so no running chain breaks — lanes migrate at their next Chrome-gate start; the lint WARNS on a tool default inside a legacy row until that date and FAILS after it (and fails on the row itself once it has expired). run-gate refuses a --band narrower than the layout minimum by name and never widens across any declared boundary (CI reserved, plan or legacy). The lint (node web/tools/ci-bands-lint.mjs; hygiene arm 8g) refuses any tool default whose FULL derived range (base + declared PORT_INVENTORY) intersects any declared band; a tool that derives ports from a base without declaring an inventory fails as 'undeclared-inventory'.
